intro: The Panther Cage Key is a small metal key held by Wizlo Bearingshiner at Whitereach Post. It unlocks a reinforced cage holding an enraged, captive predator within the wreckage of an ambushed caravan in Thousand Needles.

p: When a traveling caravan was attacked and ransacked by centaur raiders north of Whitereach Post, the goblin tinker Wizlo Bearingshiner barely escaped with his life. Amid the ruins of wagons and plundered cargo, the marauders left one thing entirely untouched: a sturdy cage housing a ferocious, rare panther. Around the predator's neck hung Wizlo's prized invention, a hypercapacitor gizmo. Unwilling to approach the snarling beast, the centaur gave the cage a wide berth, leaving Wizlo's key as the only way to open the door and retrieve the device.
